title: Highly recommend: 10/10!!!
text: This excursion was definitely one of the highlights of our entire stay in the Barcelona area! I highly recommend this amazing time out on the water. The swim stop was so much fun! The tapas absolutely tasty. The captain and crew duo: Ivy and Molly made this sailing tour even better with their awesome personalities! They even let us help raise and lower the sails! Don't hesitate to book!
author: kellylP1733YM

title: Thank you Seb and Maria for a blissful 2 hours of sailing. Food was incredible with great selection of drinks and music.
text: Welcomed onto the boat by the lovely Maria who was a fantastic host for our 2 hour sailing experience. It was great to try some very delicious food and be offered a range of drinks. Thank you Seb for your amazing boating knowledge and letting my son take the wheel for his first time steering a boat. It was so relaxing. Sitting listening to great songs with the amazing city of Barcelona in the background. So great to have some time out to relax and being able to have a swim off the boat was such a bonus. I would really recommend this trip to anyone.
author: Elizabeth P

title: Highly recommend!!! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
text: Ivy and Maria ( best skipper and host possible) were the absolute best! 12/10 can recommend we had so much fun and laughed so much... it was the best time, the food was delicious, the people were great and the views were amazing ...everything was great!!
author: clarissa b

title: Great day at the sea with fun people
text: Amazing time at the sea! We had a really nice group and the Service on the boat of course was amazing also. Great tapas and good selection of drinks. Highly recommend this tour to everyone
author: Sini85

text: Amazing! Wonderful crew, good food, cold drinks and 10/10 vibzzzzz. Will for sure do this again next time I'm visiting Barcelona
author: Victor  L

title: Highly recommend - great sailing experience
text: Amazing experience. Seb and Connor were great captains and let us get involved with the sailing as much as we wanted to. A really relaxed atmosphere and plenty of drinks on board for everyone. The sea swimming was also a lot of fun. Excellent communication throughout the booking process too. Thanks a lot for making it such a great trip!
author: jdalziel7

title: Best time
text: It was the most relaxing and highly enjoyable thing we did in Barcelona. The views were wonderful, would recommend this to everyone.
author: J9521TMmariac

title: Best way to spend an afternoon!
text: My friends and I were in Barcelona for the day for school trip, and we thought this would be a fun way to spend a couple hours! We ended up with our 2 amazing guides, Steve and faith, who not only kept us entertained, but made the experience amazing all around. Right before it was time for us to leave. It started raining, and they let us sit on the boat, eating snacks and drinking drinks, talking and messing around for an hour until the rain let up after that we did the entire two hour tour, and it has easily become, a highlight for all of us! We would definitely recommend!
author: AnnaLynn_P

title: Great experience!
text: The crew were very friendly and we had a great time on the boat, thank you very much! We were a group of 8 friends.
